title: AI link department
short: Enterprise assistants, model APIs, open/local models, RAG, agents and AI governance
description: Dedicated AI bookmarks for enterprise IT: multi-vendor assistants, model/API docs, open and local inference, RAG/vector tools, agent frameworks, evaluation/observability, and governance (AI Act, NIST, OWASP) — with clear docs vs product vs community labels.
intro: AI changes quickly. These links help you find vendor docs and public standards. A listing is not permission to send company data to a model or SaaS. Prefer enterprise contracts, SSO/Conditional Access, retention controls and an approved-tools inventory before any production use.
guardrails: Do not paste secrets, personal data or regulated content into consumer AI tools. Treat prompts and uploads as potentially retained by the provider unless your contract and admin settings say otherwise. Cross-check decisions against your organisation’s AI policy.
